plain: To say that something comes from, or was caused by, a person or thing

webster.text: To allot or attach, in contemplation; to ascribe; to consider as belonging.

more.text: To give as due; to yield as an act of the mind; as, to attribute to God all the glory of redemption.
To impute, as to a cause; as, our misfortunes are generally to be attributed to our follies or imprudence.

example.quote: A project of this kind is little less romantic than the monster-taming spirit which is attributed to the fabulous heroes and demi-gods of antiquity.
